example_prompt: Check whether the Cartflox payment link I shared has been paid.

id.description: Identifier of the payment link (`id` returned at creation, not the slug). Passed as a path parameter.

status.description: `SUCCESS` when paid; otherwise `WAITING` (no attempt yet) or the status of the latest non-failed attempt (`PENDING`, `CANCELLED`, `REFUNDED`).

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Pass the link id returned at creation, not its slug.

Until a payment succeeds the answer is { success: true, paid: false, status: "WAITING" } or the status of the latest non-failed attempt (PENDING, CANCELLED, REFUNDED); transaction is present when paid is true.
It returns only the most recent successful payment of the link, not a list of payments.

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.

spans: Identifier of the payment link (`id` returned at creation, not the slug).
succeeds, the answer is `{ "success": true, "paid": false, "status": "WAITING" }`,
or the status of the latest non-failed attempt.
Returns the most recent successful payment of the link, if any.
Errors are reported by the HTTP status code and a JSON body `{ "error": "<message>" }`.
API key missing or invalid: `Missing API key` or `Invalid API Key`
